zh-CN.summary: 所有东西都在自己的命名空间里运行。镜像以 digest 固定版本，工作负载都用非 root 用户运行，网络访问压到最低，也没有默认密码。

zh-TW.summary: 所有東西都在自己的命名空間裡執行。映像檔以 digest 固定版本，工作負載都用非 root 使用者執行，網路存取壓到最低，也沒有預設密碼。

zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可。只能用在允许的范围：公司内部业务、个人或非商业用途。想把 n8n 当托管服务转售，要另外跟 n8n 签约。
zh-CN.risk: n8n 用的是 Sustainable Use License。源码看得到，但不算 OSI 认可的开源许可。企业版文件另有条款。

zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。只能用在允許的範圍：公司內部業務、個人或非商業用途。想把 n8n 當託管服務轉賣，要另外跟 n8n 簽約。
zh-TW.risk: n8n 用的是 Sustainable Use License。原始碼看得到，但不算 OSI 認可的開源授權。企業版檔案另有條款。

risks.mitigation: The template description names the license. Deploy only for permitted internal business, personal or noncommercial use. To resell hosted n8n, you need a separate agreement with n8n.
risks.risk: n8n uses the Sustainable Use License. You can read the source, but it is not OSI-approved open source. Enterprise files have separate terms.

zh-CN.mitigation: 管理员只给信任的人。任务执行器（运行工作流代码的部分）是隔离的，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，文件系统只读，也读不到环境变量。危险的 executeCommand 和 localFileTrigger 节点已经移除。对外连接没有限制，所以请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则），让工作流连不到私有地址。社区包工具是开启的，管理员要自己检查每个安装的包。
zh-CN.risk: 工作流的作者可以调用外部服务、安装代码，或做出权限很大的集成。

zh-TW.mitigation: 管理員只給信任的人。任務執行器（執行工作流程程式碼的部分）是隔離的，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，檔案系統唯讀，也讀不到環境變數。危險的 executeCommand 和 localFileTrigger 節點已經移除。對外連線沒有限制，所以請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則），讓工作流程連不到私有位址。社群套件工具是開啟的，管理員要自己檢查每個安裝的套件。
zh-TW.risk: 工作流程的作者可以呼叫外部服務、安裝程式碼，或做出權限很大的整合。

risks.mitigation: Only let trusted people be administrators. The task runner (the part that runs workflow code) is isolated, has no Kubernetes token and has a read-only filesystem. It cannot read environment variables. The dangerous executeCommand and localFileTrigger nodes are removed. Outbound traffic is not limited, so add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to keep workflows away from private addresses. Community package tools are enabled, so administrators must check each package they install.
risks.risk: Workflow authors can call outside providers, install code or build powerful integrations.

zh-CN.mitigation: 模板用的是 n8n v2.17 以后支持的托管所有者变量。n8n 启动前，就先把自动生成的机密做成 bcrypt 哈希（单向打乱的形式）设好。每次重启，部署变量都会再设置一次所有者的邮箱和密码。公开注册保持关闭。
zh-CN.risk: 公开的实例如果还没设置好，第一个来的访客就能抢走所有者账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: 範本用的是 n8n v2.17 以後支援的託管擁有者變數。n8n 啟動前，就先把自動產生的機密做成 bcrypt 雜湊（單向打亂的形式）設好。每次重新啟動，部署變數都會再設定一次擁有者的 Email 和密碼。公開註冊維持關閉。
zh-TW.risk: 公開的實例如果還沒設定好，第一個來的訪客就能搶走擁有者帳號。

risks.mitigation: The template uses the managed-owner variables (n8n v2.17 and later). A bcrypt hash (a one-way scrambled form) of the generated Secret is set before n8n starts. The deployment variables set the owner email and password again at each restart. Public sign-up stays closed.
risks.risk: On a public instance that is not set up yet, the first visitor could claim the owner account.

zh-CN.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个数据库集群各建一组权限。这个例外绝不会用在 n8n 和任务执行器的 Pod 上。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）必须用数据库 operator 创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個資料庫叢集各建一組權限。這個例外絕不會套用到 n8n 和任務執行器的 Pod。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）必須用資料庫 operator 建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: The cloudnative-pg component creates separate permissions for each database cluster. This exception never applies to the n8n and task-runner Pods.
risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) must call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the database operator creates.

zh-CN.mitigation: 你在 n8n 里设置好 SMTP 之前，邀请邮件和重置密码邮件都发不出去。
zh-CN.risk: 没有设置 SMTP 服务器。

zh-TW.mitigation: 你在 n8n 裡設定好 SMTP 之前，邀請信和重設密碼信都寄不出去。
zh-TW.risk: 沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器。

risks.mitigation: Email invitations and password-reset mail do not work until you configure SMTP in n8n.

security.summary: Everything runs in its own namespace. Images are pinned by digest and workloads run as non-root users. Network access is kept to the minimum. There are no default passwords.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: n8n-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: n8n
        app: n8n
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      # The Service n8n would set N8N_PORT to its address.
      enableServiceLinks: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: n8n
        image: docker.io/n8nio/n8n:3.2.2@sha256:c5d94cb443ff3d7b3abd65927fd8c9af1281f026ebfed9b208cf8d0f6b199a94
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 2000m
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /home/node/.n8n
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: cache
          mountPath: /home/node/.cache
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 5678
        - name: broker
          containerPort: 5679
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5678
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz/readiness
            port: 5678
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 5678
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 6
        env:
        - name: DB_TYPE
          value: postgresdb
        - name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
          value: Asia/Taipei
        - name: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE
          value: 'true'
        - name: N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE
          value: 'true'
        - name: N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE
          value: filesystem
        - name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED
          value: 'false'
        - name: N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS
          value: 'true'
        - name: N8N_HOST
          value: '{{ .Domain }}'
        - name: N8N_PROTOCOL
          value: https
        - name: N8N_PROXY_HOPS
          value: '1'
        - name: WEBHOOK_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}/
        - name: N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}/
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_MODE
          value: external
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS
          value: 0.0.0.0
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT
          value: '5679'
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-secrets
              key: runner-token
        - name: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-secrets
              key: encryption-key
        - name: NODE_ENV
          value: production
        - name: NODES_EXCLUDE
          value: '["n8n-nodes-base.executeCommand","n8n-nodes-base.localFileTrigger"]'
        - name: N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_MANAGED_BY_ENV
          value: 'true'
        - name: N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_EMAIL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.ownerEmail }}'
        - name: N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_FIRST_NAME
          value: Instance
        - name: N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_LAST_NAME
          value: Owner
        - name: OWNER_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-secrets
              key: owner-password
        - name: N8N_USER_FOLDER
          value: /home/node
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE
          value: n8n
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST
          value: n8n-db-rw
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT
          value: '5432'
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_USER
          value: n8n
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-db-app
              key: password
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_SSL_ENABLED
          value: 'true'
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
          value: 'true'
        - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_SSL_CA
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-db-ca
              key: ca.crt
        command:
        - tini
        - --
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - export N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH="$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(require("/usr/local/lib/node_modules/n8n/node_modules/bcryptjs").hashSync(process.env.OWNER_PASSWORD,12))')";
          unset OWNER_PASSWORD; exec /docker-entrypoint.sh start
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: n8n-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      - name: cache
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app: n8n
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 5678
    targetPort: 5678
  - name: broker
    port: 5679
    targetPort: 5679
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.tls: 'true'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: n8n-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: n8n
            port:
              number: 5678
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: task-runner
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: task-runner
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: n8n
        app: task-runner
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: task-runner
        image: docker.io/n8nio/runners:3.2.2@sha256:7e64bb2cbcfddf644dbb1f6ef703ce6e70adf8880f6494c870dcc54aa976f099
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: home
          mountPath: /home/runner
        ports:
        - name: database
          containerPort: 5680
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5680
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5680
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 5680
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        env:
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: n8n-secrets
              key: runner-token
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
          value: http://n8n:5679
        - name: N8N_RUNNERS_LAUNCHER_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
          value: '5680'
        - name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
          value: Asia/Taipei
        - name: N8N_BLOCK_RUNNER_ENV_ACCESS
          value: 'true'
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      - name: home
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: n8n-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: n8n
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:17@sha256:70664ebcfa1100361b5bdc28bbf06fdbe08db2dc4ad7bd14de33c5e05fe8ea8e
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: n8n
      owner: n8n
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
